name: Sales Manager & Scheduler For WooCommerce
author: wppforeveryone

sections.description:
Effortlessly automate sales, manage bulk discounts, and schedule WooCommerce promotions with ease!

Sales Manager & Scheduler for WooCommerce is the ultimate plugin for setting up and automating sales campaigns. Whether you’re running seasonal promotions, flash sales, or long-term discounts, this plugin streamlines the entire process, saving you time and increasing revenue.

Key Features

✅ Schedule Sales in Advance – Set start and end dates for sales to automate price adjustments.
✅ Bulk Pricing Management – Apply percentage-based or fixed discounts to multiple products at once.
✅ Category-Specific Discounts – Assign discounts to entire product categories effortlessly.
✅ Individual Product Pricing – Customize discounts for single products to maximize conversions.
✅ Sales Badges for Discounts – Highlight discounted products with eye-catching badges to boost sales.
✅ Custom Styling for Badges – Adjust badge appearance to match your WooCommerce store design.

💡 Optimize your WooCommerce store with automated sales scheduling and promotional tools!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Sales Manager to configure your sales settings.
  4. Create and schedule your sales effortlessly!
sections.faq:
Can I set discounts for multiple products at once?

Yes! You can apply bulk discounts across multiple products or categories with just a few clicks.

Can I schedule sales for specific time periods?

Absolutely! You can set start and end dates for sales, ensuring automatic price changes.

Does this plugin allow discounts for entire product categories?

Yes, you can assign percentage-based or fixed discounts to entire categories for seamless bulk pricing.

Can I add sales badges to discounted products?

Yes! The plugin includes a product badge feature that highlights discounted products with a customizable “SALE” badge.

Can I customize the appearance of the sales badge?

Yes, you can style the badges to match your WooCommerce store design using custom CSS.

Will the discounts be removed automatically after the sale ends?

Yes, the plugin automatically reverts product prices to their original values when the sale ends.

Is this plugin SEO-friendly?

Yes! The plugin ensures structured, search-friendly content for promotions and discounts, improving product visibility.
